name: _selected.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  awards-carousel/_selected.scss — the selected-work variant — near-full-viewport slides with adjacent peek, cover image, and the active-only label.
//  Imported by awards-carousel.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  VARIANT: selected work
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
.aw-c--selected {
  position: relative;

  // ── Slide widths: slightly narrower than viewport so adjacent slides peek ──
  // The section has no lateral padding (home.scss zeros it),
  // so 88vw slides → ~6vw peeking in from each side.
  // Gap between slides gives visual breathing room.
  .aw-c-track {
    gap: to-rem($space-xl);

    @include layout-768() {
      gap: to-rem($space-2xl);
    }
    @include layout-1440() {
      gap: to-rem($space-3xl);
    }
  }

  .aw-c-slide {
    width: 88vw;
    flex-basis: 88vw;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    position: relative;

    @include layout-768() {
      width: 82vw;
      flex-basis: 82vw;
    }
    @include layout-1024() {
      width: 78vw;
      flex-basis: 78vw;
    }
    @include layout-1440() {
      width: 72vw;
      flex-basis: 72vw;
    }
    @include layout-2560() {
      width: 66vw;
      flex-basis: 66vw;
    }
  }

  // ── Cover image ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Uses a CSS custom property --cover-max-h set by JS to fit the viewport.
  .aw-c-cover {
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 16 / 7;
    max-height: var(--cover-max-h, 80vh);
    overflow: hidden;
    background: var(--grey-2);
    flex-shrink: 0;

    &-img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      object-position: center;
      display: block;
    }

    &--skel {
      aspect-ratio: 16 / 7;
      max-height: var(--cover-max-h, 80vh);

      background: linear-gradient(
        90deg,
        var(--skel-bg-1) 25%,
        var(--skel-bg-2) 50%,
        var(--skel-bg-3) 75%
      );
      background-size: 200% 100%;
      animation: skeleton-shimmer 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
  }

  // ── Label: hidden on adjacent, fades in only on active slide ─────────────
  // No %MAXAREA — the label sits inside the slide, so text aligns with the
  // slide's left edge. The archive title is aligned separately.
  .aw-c-label {
    padding: to-rem($space-sm) 0 to-rem($space-xl);
    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    transition:
      opacity 0.4s ease,
      visibility 0.4s;
    pointer-events: none;

    &-title {
      @extend .ttl-md;

      font-weight: 200;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding-bottom: to-rem($space-lg);
    }

    &-desc {
      @extend .txt-md;

      font-weight: 300;
    }

    // "Click to open" — centered, corner-border animation on hover
    &-action {
      @extend %RESETBTN;
      @extend .ttl-xs;

      position: relative;
      display: block;
      text-align: center;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: to-rem($space-xs) to-rem($space-lg);
      color: var(--text-muted-on-dark);
      font-weight: 700;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: color 0.2s ease;
      margin: to-rem($space-xl) auto 0;
      width: fit-content;
      opacity: 0;
      visibility: hidden;
      pointer-events: none;

      &::before,
      &::after {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        width: to-rem($space-md);
        height: to-rem($space-md);
        transition:
          width 0.25s ease,
          height 0.25s ease;
      }

      &::before {
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--grey);
        border-left: 1px solid var(--grey);
      }

      &::after {
        bottom: 0;
        right: 0;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--grey);
        border-right: 1px solid var(--grey);
      }

      &:hover,
      &:focus {
        color: var(--black);
      }

      &:hover::before,
      &:focus::before,
      &:hover::after,
      &:focus::after {
        width: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-xs)});
        height: calc(100% - #{to-rem($space-xs)});
      }
    }
  }

  .aw-c-slide--active .aw-c-label {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    pointer-events: auto;
  }

  // Action button appears after the description animation finishes
  .aw-c-slide--active .aw-c-label-action {
    animation: action-appear 0.4s ease-out forwards;
    animation-delay: var(--action-delay, 0ms);
  }

  // home-item-link fills the full slide
  .home-item-link {
    width: 100%;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
  }
}
